excluded_from_primary.reason: step_abs_hi.mean_firing_rate_Hz reproduces on only 25-50% of audit points at dt = 0.05 and 0.025 ms, on both the published 9,875-segment mesh and the 4,096-segment d_lambda mesh. A fast-spiking cell at ~145 Hz puts one or two spikes per 400 ms window inside the tolerance, and the step needed to resolve them is finer than 0.0125 ms
excluded_from_primary.remediation: a converged campaign would cost ~4 h per 256 samples at 0.00625 ms on this morphology; not affordable in this release. Adapter, mechanisms, calibration and the failing audit are retained so it can be resumed
